On veut répondre à une première question
Est ce que les imports sont une marge d'ajustement fce aux chocs d'offre


```{r}


price_merge_CBF <-price_merge_CBF %>% 
  mutate(SCH_EX_DA_FR_ES = as.numeric(SCH_EX_DA_FR_ES),
         SCH_EX_DA_ES_FR = as.numeric(SCH_EX_DA_ES_FR),
         SCH_EX_TOT_FR_ES = as.numeric(SCH_EX_TOT_FR_ES),
         SCH_EX_TOT_ES_FR = as.numeric(SCH_EX_TOT_ES_FR),
        SCH_EX_Spread_FR_ES = SCH_EX_TOT_FR_ES - SCH_EX_DA_FR_ES ,
         SCH_EX_Spread_ES_FR = SCH_EX_TOT_ES_FR - SCH_EX_DA_ES_FR)

colnames_with_capacity <- colnames(price_merge_CBF)[grepl("Capacity", colnames(price_merge_CBF))]
#get monthly avg of unavailabilities
capacity_fields <- 
  c(colnames_with_capacity,
    "day_ahead_forecast_esp",  "unpredicted_renewables_esp", "intraday_update_renewables_esp",
  "day_ahead_forecast_fr",  "unpredicted_renewables_fr", "intraday_update_renewables_fr")

price_merge_CBF[colnames_with_capacity] <- lapply(price_merge_CBF[colnames_with_capacity], function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), 0, x))

price_merge_CBF$weekday <- weekdays(price_merge_CBF$delivery_date)

```
On cherche à savoir si les renouvelables et les indispos en France et en Espagne sont corrélés ?


```{r}
price_merge_CBF %>% 
  select(day_ahead_forecast_esp, unpredicted_renewables_esp, intraday_update_renewables_esp,
         day_ahead_forecast_fr, unpredicted_renewables_fr, intraday_update_renewables_fr) %>% 
  cor(use = "complete.obs")
```




```{r}

import_data <- price_merge_CBF %>% 
  select(SCH_EX_Spread_FR_ES, SCH_EX_Spread_ES_FR, 
         SCH_EX_DA_FR_ES, SCH_EX_DA_ES_FR,
         year, month, weekday,
         Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp,
         Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr,
         Planned.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp,Planned.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr,
         day_ahead_forecast_esp, unpredicted_renewables_esp, intraday_update_renewables_esp,
         day_ahead_forecast_fr, unpredicted_renewables_fr, intraday_update_renewables_fr, datetime) %>% 
  na.omit()

m_ES_FR <- lm(SCH_EX_Spread_ES_FR ~ SCH_EX_DA_ES_FR+
                Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp+
                      Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr+
                Planned.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp+
                      Planned.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr+
                      day_ahead_forecast_esp + unpredicted_renewables_esp + intraday_update_renewables_esp+
                      day_ahead_forecast_fr + unpredicted_renewables_fr + intraday_update_renewables_fr,
                    data = import_data)



m_FR_ES <- lm(SCH_EX_Spread_FR_ES ~ SCH_EX_DA_FR_ES +Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp+
                      Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr+
                Planned.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp+
                      Planned.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr+
                      day_ahead_forecast_esp + unpredicted_renewables_esp + intraday_update_renewables_esp+
                      day_ahead_forecast_fr + unpredicted_renewables_fr + intraday_update_renewables_fr,
                    data = import_data)

m_ES_FR_FE <- lm(SCH_EX_Spread_ES_FR ~ SCH_EX_DA_ES_FR +
                   Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp+
                      Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr+
                   Planned.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp+
                      Planned.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr+
                      day_ahead_forecast_esp + unpredicted_renewables_esp + intraday_update_renewables_esp+
                      day_ahead_forecast_fr + unpredicted_renewables_fr + intraday_update_renewables_fr+
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month) + as.factor(weekday),
                    data = import_data)

m_FR_ES_FE <- lm(SCH_EX_Spread_FR_ES~ SCH_EX_DA_FR_ES +Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp+
                      Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr+
                   Planned.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp+
                      Planned.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr+
                      day_ahead_forecast_esp + unpredicted_renewables_esp + intraday_update_renewables_esp+
                      day_ahead_forecast_fr + unpredicted_renewables_fr + intraday_update_renewables_fr+ 
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month) + as.factor(weekday),
                    data = import_data)


```

```{r, results = 'asis'}


reg_table <- stargazer( m_FR_ES,  m_FR_ES_FE, m_ES_FR, m_ES_FR_FE,
    type = "html",
    dep.var.labels.include = FALSE,
    #se = list(cl_se_log, cl_se_log_FE, cl_se_control),
    title = "Regression Results",
    column.labels = c("FR -> ES",  "FR -> ES (with FE)", "ES -> FR", "ES -> FR (with FE)"),
    keep = c("Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp", "SCH_EX_DA_FR_ES", "SCH_EX_DA_ES_FR",
              "Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr",
             "Planned.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp",
                      "Planned.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr",
              "day_ahead_forecast_esp","unpredicted_renewables_esp", "intraday_update_renewables_esp",
                      "day_ahead_forecast_fr", "unpredicted_renewables_fr", "intraday_update_renewables_fr")
)
 
```

On a donc établi que les imports sont une marge d'ajustement face aux chocs d'offre
sur le marché intradaily
Cette marge pourrait se décomposer entre un effet prix et un effet géographique
à savoir une fois que je contrôle par la différence de prix qu'engendre ce choc d'offre national,
est ce que je trouve le même effet ?
On a pas les prix intradaily ici, mais on peut se posser la question sur le marché day ahead.


```{r}

import_data <- price_merge_CBF %>% 
  select(SCH_EX_Spread_FR_ES, SCH_EX_Spread_ES_FR, 
         SCH_EX_DA_FR_ES, SCH_EX_DA_ES_FR,
         price_fr, price_esp,
         year, month, weekday,
         Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp,
         Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr,
         Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp,Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr,
         Planned.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp,Planned.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr,
         day_ahead_forecast_esp, unpredicted_renewables_esp, intraday_update_renewables_esp,
         day_ahead_forecast_fr, unpredicted_renewables_fr, intraday_update_renewables_fr, datetime) %>% 
  mutate(price_diff_fr_esp = price_fr - price_esp,
         #contrary to CBF I allow for negative CBF
         # with the convention that ESP to FR is >0
         CBF_DA = SCH_EX_DA_ES_FR - SCH_EX_DA_FR_ES
         ) %>%
  na.omit()

m_CBF <- lm(CBF_DA ~ 
              price_esp + price_diff_fr_esp+
                Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp+
                      Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr+
                Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp+
                      Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr+
                      day_ahead_forecast_esp + unpredicted_renewables_esp + intraday_update_renewables_esp+
                      day_ahead_forecast_fr + unpredicted_renewables_fr + intraday_update_renewables_fr,
                    data = import_data)


m_CBF_FE <- lm(CBF_DA ~ price_esp + price_diff_fr_esp+
                   Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp+
                      Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr+
                   Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp+
                      Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr+
                      day_ahead_forecast_esp + unpredicted_renewables_esp + intraday_update_renewables_esp+
                      day_ahead_forecast_fr + unpredicted_renewables_fr + intraday_update_renewables_fr+
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month) + as.factor(weekday),
                    data = import_data)


```

```{r, results = 'asis'}


reg_table <- stargazer( m_CBF, m_CBF_FE,
    type = "html",
    #se = list(cl_se_log, cl_se_log_FE, cl_se_control),
    title = "Regression Results",
    column.labels = c("ES -> FR", "ES -> FR (with FE)"),
    keep = c("Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp", "SCH_EX_DA_FR_ES", "SCH_EX_DA_ES_FR",
              "Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr",
             "price_diff_fr_esp", "price_fr", "price_esp",
             "Planned.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp",
                      "Planned.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr",
             "Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp",
                      "Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr",
              "day_ahead_forecast_esp","unpredicted_renewables_esp", "intraday_update_renewables_esp",
                      "day_ahead_forecast_fr", "unpredicted_renewables_fr", "intraday_update_renewables_fr")
)
 
```


On regarde une transmission chocs de prix à l'étranger

On vérifie qu'en contrôlant par la différence de prix, ce lien disparaît

On considère d'abord l'effet des indispos + renouvelables (chocs d'offre) sur le prix en Espagne

```{r}

# perform first stage regression

     gen_tot+ day_ahead_forecast,
  data= price_merge_CBF)


vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_rf , type = "HC0", cluster = ~ cl_rf_id_esp)
cl_se_rf_esp <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))

m_rf_FE <- lm(
  log(price_fr) ~ Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp + Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp+ 
    Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp + 
    gen_tot+ day_ahead_forecast   +
    spot_gas + unpredicted_renewables + intraday_update_renewables + 
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month) + as.factor(weekday),
  data= price_merge_CBF)
# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée

# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_rf_FE <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))
```
